nodes.label: Supabase JWT Auth Pattern
nodes.rationale: Supabase owns auth credentials; backend validates JWTs by calling supabase.auth.get_user() rather than verifying locally. Falls back to email lookup for pre-migration users whose local UUID differs from Supabase auth UUID.

nodes.label: Inline Startup Migration Pattern
nodes.rationale: Schema patches run as raw SQL at startup (idempotent IF NOT EXISTS guards) in addition to Alembic. This ensures schema is always up-to-date even when Alembic is not run explicitly after deployment.

nodes.label: n8n Brief Webhook Integration Pattern
nodes.rationale: brief/start uses strict_response=True (requires structured JSON with mode field); brief/submit uses strict_response=False (any 2xx = delivery confirmed, supports async n8n Respond Immediately mode). Idempotency via X-Idempotency-Key prevents duplicate processing on timeout retries.

nodes.label: Watermark & Delivery File Gating
nodes.rationale: Clients see watermarked previews only after watermark_delivered state; original files only after final_delivered. All AI/review internal fields are stripped from client-facing submission responses.

nodes.label: Token-based Image Callback Security
nodes.rationale: 32-byte cryptographically random URL-safe token embedded in the n8n callback URL replaces X-Webhook-Secret for image results. Single-use, 24-hour expiry. Token itself provides 256-bit entropy equivalent to a secret header.

nodes.label: Brief Workflow (Client â†’ Manager â†’ Worker)
nodes.rationale: The AgencyFlow platform orchestrates a brief lifecycle: client submits guided brief â†’ manager reviews/validates â†’ worker is assigned â†’ worker submits deliverables â†’ AI review â†’ final delivery
nodes.norm_label: brief workflow (client a†’ manager a†’ worker)

nodes.label: n8n Webhook Integration
nodes.rationale: Four n8n webhooks drive async AI processing: BRIEF_WEBHOOK_URL for brief generation, AI_REVIEW_WEBHOOK_URL and TASK_REVIEW_WEBHOOK_URL for work review, IMAGE_PROCESSING_WEBHOOK_URL for watermarking

nodes.label: Four-Role Access System
nodes.rationale: Platform enforces four roles: client (creates briefs), admin (user management), manager (brief review/project assignment), employee/worker (task execution). Each role has a distinct dashboard.

nodes.label: Supabase Auth and JWT Validation
nodes.rationale: Supabase handles auth; JWTs validated server-side via deps.py; frontend uses @supabase/supabase-js

nodes.label: Watermark and Delivery Flow
nodes.rationale: Submitted images are processed via IMAGE_PROCESSING_WEBHOOK_URL; watermarked previews vs. final files handled by delivery_service.py; files stored in Supabase Storage buckets

nodes.label: Task Status Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Tasks progress through: todo â†’ in_progress â†’ submitted â†’ under_ai_review â†’ (revision_requested | approved) â†’ completed. Late status added by background checker.

nodes.label: Brief Status Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Brief statuses: draft â†’ in_progress â†’ interrupted â†’ submitted â†’ clarification_requested â†’ validated â†’ converted (or rejected/failed_start). Only in_progress/interrupted are resumable.

nodes.label: Project Status Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Project statuses: briefing â†’ planning â†’ active â†’ on_hold â†’ completed â†’ delivered â†’ archived
